items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Even someone like Bud Freeman, who I got to know a little bit too.

ctx.x: I supposed it’s interesting for them to see that the music is — now I’m on stage at Carnegie Hall.

Well I’m sure, yeah. Even someone like Bud Freeman, who I got to know a little bit too. He started out playing in speakeasies and stuff in Chicago, and later was able to tour around and just do his thing. It’s hard to generalize. I mean each one is such a unique individual too.
What’s it like to travel overseas? Is the music accepted or not accepted in a different fashion?
